_provenance.source: RFC 7693 (The BLAKE2 Cryptographic Hash and MAC), Appendix B — BLAKE2s-256 example
_provenance.kind: published known-answer test for the BLAKE2s primitive
_provenance.note: This fixture pins the BLAKE2s primitive by its published RFC known-answer. The byte-for-byte CROSS-IMPLEMENTATION Noise_IK_25519_ChaChaPoly_BLAKE2s handshake vector (which alone distinguishes BLAKE2s from SHA-256 by value at the Noise layer) is DEFERRED to #30, where the Go flynn/noise responder emits reference bytes the JS initiator must match — a stronger proof than a static file. No published Noise-IK vector for this suite was obtainable credential-free in this sandbox: the noise-c.wasm npm package excludes its tests/ directory, and web fetch is unavailable. A self-generated 'vector' was deliberately NOT fabricated, as it would prove nothing about hash correctness.
